scripts.build: npm run bundle && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist','public'].forEach(d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('app.js',d+'/app.js'); let html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').replace('/src/main.tsx','./app.js'); fs.writeFileSync(d+'/index.html',html); if(fs.existsSync('404.html'))fs.copyFileSync('404.html',d+'/404.html'); if(fs.existsSync('style.css'))fs.copyFileSync('style.css',d+'/style.css');}); if(fs.existsSync('public/manifest.json'))fs.copyFileSync('public/manifest.json','dist/manifest.json'); if(fs.existsSync('public/favicon.png'))fs.copyFileSync('public/favicon.png','dist/favicon.png'); if(fs.existsSync('public/logo.png'))fs.copyFileSync('public/logo.png','dist/logo.png'); if(fs.existsSync('public/assets'))fs.cpSync('public/assets','dist/assets',{recursive:true});"
